name: obs-extra-audio
description: Extra audio tracks in OBS/Aitum recordings and Replay Buffer/Backtrack clips, with optional MP3 contingency.
long_description: Configure Tracks 7-16 and embed them in original main/Aitum MP4 recordings and replay clips. Extra audio follows each canvas's exact native recording and replay pause/resume boundaries. Existing video encoders and native pause behavior are preserved; no additional video encoders are created. Extra tracks use the selected main OBS AAC encoder. Source assignments and native live/VOD slots stay user-controlled. Optional full-recording MP3 backups follow each canvas's own start, stop and pauses, with configurable names under Recording Path/Extra Audio/Main or Vertical.
